verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows a basic Gazebo simulation launch tutorial (ros2-docs-16); there is no mention of synthetic training-data generation, reinforcement learning frameworks, or scaling simulation for RL training. This is a fair axis for a robotics middleware with a simulation ecosystem, but no supporting evidence exists. Missing for 10: RL training integration (e.g. Isaac Gym/Isaac Sim, OpenAI Gym bridges), synthetic data/domain-randomization tooling, and evidence of scaled parallel simulation for training.
